releaseNotes: V1004 fixes the Device Scene primitive color editor visibility regression found in V1003.

Appearance is now nested inside the same primitive-only Geometry panel, so any Rectangle, Rounded Rectangle, Ellipse, Line or Text that exposes Geometry necessarily exposes the color editor directly below it.
The existing schema-v5 FillHex/StrokeHex fields, preset swatches, HEX/token editors and Save Properties commit boundary are unchanged.
The V1002 resize interaction overlay remains the protected resize baseline and is not modified by this patch.

en: The primitive Appearance color editor is now guaranteed to appear directly below Geometry in the Inspector.
Existing FillHex/StrokeHex palettes and Save Properties behavior are unchanged.
The V1002 resize interaction overlay remains unchanged.
ko: Primitive Appearance 색상 편집기가 Inspector의 Geometry 바로 아래에 항상 표시되도록 수정했습니다.
기존 FillHex/StrokeHex 팔레트와 속성 저장 동작은 변경하지 않았습니다.
V1002 Resize Interaction Overlay는 변경하지 않았습니다.
ja: Primitive の Appearance カラーエディターが Inspector の Geometry 直下に必ず表示されるよう修正しました。
既存の FillHex/StrokeHex パレットとプロパティ保存動作は変更していません。
V1002 Resize Interaction Overlay は変更していません。
zh-CN: 已修复 Primitive Appearance 颜色编辑器，使其始终显示在 Inspector 的 Geometry 正下方。
现有 FillHex/StrokeHex 调色板和保存属性行为保持不变。

de: Der Primitive-Appearance-Farbeditor wird jetzt garantiert direkt unter Geometry im Inspector angezeigt.
Die bestehenden FillHex/StrokeHex-Paletten und das Speichern der Eigenschaften bleiben unverändert.
Das V1002 Resize Interaction Overlay bleibt unverändert.
es: El editor de color Appearance de Primitive ahora se muestra siempre justo debajo de Geometry en el Inspector.
Las paletas FillHex/StrokeHex existentes y el comportamiento de Guardar propiedades no cambian.
